canonical_title: Yaw rate response to lateral gusts

versions.title_at_revision: Yaw rate response to lateral gusts
versions.text:
Standard: In hover and low airspeed (up to 45 KGS), in the 3 seconds following a step lateral gust input, the ratio of peak yaw rate to gust speed is no greater than 1.0 (deg/s)/(ft/s) unless pilot evaluation determines the air vehicle handling qualities are no worse than Level 2. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis to assess the yaw rate response to lateral gust inputs as specified in MIL- DTL-32742, Yaw Rate Response to Lateral Gusts paragraph for each air vehicle configuration and loading within the SFE. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess the yaw rate response to lateral gust inputs as specified in MIL-DTL-32742, Yaw Rate Response to Lateral Gusts paragraph for each air vehicle configuration and loading within the SFE. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess the yaw rate response to lateral gust inputs as specified in MIL-DTL-32742, Yaw Rate Response to Lateral Gusts paragraph for selected combinations of air vehicle configuration and loading within the SFE.
